summary.text: Everett Corley is the Republican candidate for Kentucky State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Karen Berg.
A real estate agent and University of Louisville graduate, he won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary over Sheeba Jolly.

paragraphs.text: Corley was born in Louisville and received a bachelor's degree from the University of Louisville in 1991, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as real estate agent.
Corley has run for office several times before.

He was the Republican nominee for Kentucky House District 43 in 2014 and 2018, losing to Darryl Owens and Charles Booker respectively, and he was a candidate in the 2016 Republican primary for Kentucky's 3rd Congressional District, finishing second to Harold Bratcher.
In 2022 he finished third in the Republican primary for Kentucky State Senate District 26.
In the 2026 Republican primary for the same seat he received 82.4 percent of the vote, defeating Sheeba Jolly.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey for the State Senate race, Corley described himself as a fifth-generation Kentuckian and said his key messages were repealing property taxes as a means of financing schools, supporting law enforcement and tougher sentences, and a law permanently protecting Kentucky's war memorials.
